what.text: The room inside the mountain that the game returns to: the year sheet, the advisory fire, the cord board, the wardrobe and the trophy wall. It is a place in an island game and it is not a room at Bonney Lake High School.

when.text: Whenever a student walks through the tunnel on the hub island, which is most of a session.

how_to_join.text: You do not join it. Everybody who plays is already inside it within the first few minutes.

content.blurb: the room the game returns to
